newsitem.title: UK: United News up as Hoare Govett positive.
newsitem.headline: United News up as Hoare Govett positive.

text.p: Shares in British media group United News Plc rose on Friday as analysts at ABN AMRO Hoare Govett repeated a positive stance on the stock following news that licence payments by ITV companies would be reduced next year, dealers said.
The stock was up 14-1/2p at 691-1/2 by 1059 GMT.
Carlton Communications Plc, another major television broadcaster, also rose to be up 11-1/2p at 527.

A report in the Financial Times said the Independent Television Commission (ITC) had promised that the 400 million stg paid by ITV companies to the government would drop next year as a result of a revaluation.
It said savings for ITV companies could be "considerable" though the ITC refused to speculate on the sums involved.
